title: [REQ-2026-092] Consistent Background for Exhibitor Logo Upload Previews in Admin Panel
evidence: FIS area Organizer Platform; summary: exhibitor logo upload preview in the admin panel → Admin / Platform Core Global Database — Exhibitors List
what: Show exhibitor logo upload previews in the admin panel (Registration Info > Replace logo) on a consistent white background.
why: The preview background switches unpredictably between white and black, so organisers cannot judge transparency and must save and check the frontend (EP-55874).
outcome: Organisers see a reliable preview of the logo before saving.

title: [REQ-2026-093] Exhibitor Team-Level Meeting Request Deduplication for VIP Attendees
evidence: FIS area Networking & Meetings; summary: meeting requests from several team members of one exhibitor → Meetings & Matchmaking 4.1 Self-managed Meetings
what: Warn an exhibitor team member when a colleague from the same exhibitor already has a pending or confirmed meeting request with the attendee they are about to request.
why: Team members cannot see each other's requests, so VIP attendees get dozens of invites from one company and the exhibitor admin polices duplicates by hand; CloserStill Media needs it for TechShow London (related EP-37288).
outcome: VIP attendees receive coordinated outreach and team members avoid duplicate requests.

title: [REQ-2026-094] Default Event-to-App Synchronization in App Builder
evidence: FIS area Platform & Infrastructure; App Builder universal links → Mobile App App Builder and App Build Pipeline
what: Link an event to its mobile app for Universal Links by default in the App Builder, including after event cloning, so email deep links open the right app.
why: When organisers forget the manual Universal Links step, meeting and session links open another app (e.g. FeldTage instead of Potato), breaking journeys and creating support tickets; raised by DLG (EP-57021).
outcome: Deep links in event emails always open the app that belongs to that event.
needKey: default universal link event app mapping

title: [REQ-2026-095] Include Sessions in Web Floor Plan Search
evidence: FIS area Attendee Experience; summary: web floor plan search → Floor Plan Search and Filtering
what: Include session titles in the web floor plan search, as the mobile apps already do.
why: Web search returns 'No options' for sessions assigned to locations, so Frankfurter Buchmesse (FBM) attendees browse the map by hand (EP-57663).
outcome: Attendees find a session's location by searching its title on the web floor plan.
needKey: sessions in web floor plan search
